field.lossCarry: Opening loss carry for listed shares (DKK)
help.lossCarry: Enter each verified loss carry once, in nominal Danish kroner at plan start.
label: Danish taxable listed-share depot
help: Use one holding per security per depot. Danish holdings of the same company and class share an average cost across depots.
field.confirmed: Ordinary Danish listed shares and complete holdings
help.confirmed: Confirm the plan includes all ordinary post-2005 holdings of the company and only one class of its shares.
help.reporting: Confirm the purchase and any loss are reported on time to deduct eligible losses.
invalid.security: Enter a Danish security identifier and its holding quantity.
invalid.scope: Confirm ordinary Danish post-2005 listed shares, cash dividends and complete holdings.
invalid.pool: The transaction cannot be allocated to the identified average-cost pool.
invalid.price: The same security must have the same market price in every modeled depot.
invalid.money: Listed-share taxation requires the Danish 2026 annual policy.
